integrity: The proof reconstructs the published tube halfspaces, computes intrinsic projected-normal norms in the codimension-two affine hull, derives a sharp global radius upper bound by summing all two-element tube constraints, constructs the unique equality center, and proves every longer interval has strictly excess slack by a uniform symbolic inequality. Finite symbolic replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns Sack's explicit chain-poset halfspace realization for n>=3 and the inherited Euclidean metric. It does not transfer to arbitrary associahedron realizations or altered tube-height functions and does not determine the circumradius, John ellipsoid, or full vertex metric. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent unpublished observation about the same realization.
title: Two-element tubes determine the inball of Sack's chain-poset associahedron
